scope: Exact SHA-256 duplicates across source/dev tree plus deployment snapshot; application dependencies, Git objects and generated cache/temp/export trees are excluded from content scanning.

deploymentSnapshotOmitted.reason: Rebuilt by build:village then sync:village; canonical files and all Git history retained.

history: HISTORY.bundle deliberately preserves all Git history. Its compressed objects are not ordinary file copies and are not counted as removable duplicate source bytes.
historicalOptional: Unity Assets outside Resources/Audio, Packages, ProjectSettings and Tools/Archive are optional to the standard Babylon dev/test/build workflow, but are retained as editable project history/workflows. No canonical files are deleted.
preparedResources: Old app/public/assets/content and transport bundles are retained. Exact equality alone does not prove them unused by manifests, catalogs, tests or source processing; no unsafe resource pruning is inferred.

groups.recommendation: Deployment snapshot copies are omitted from the default developer ZIP. Keep registered sources, sibling glTF/FBX inputs and current prepared game resources unless all workflow/test references are proved replaceable; no files deleted.
